name: The Borrower
summary: On the Hinterlands beach, Daryn Lightwind longs to see Gammerita, a giant snapjaw. Her research keeps her away, so she sends you to Tanaris with a letter for Curgle Cranklehop.

sections.title: A Picture of Gammerita
sections.body: Daryn Lightwind has studied many subjects. Now the snapjaws along the Hinterlands beach hold her attention, especially Gammerita, a giant snapjaw. Her research keeps her where she is, so she asks you to bring back a picture of Gammerita.

sections.title: The Letter to Tanaris
sections.body: Daryn gives you a letter for Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris. Curgle made an invention that can capture a picture. Daryn believes Curgle calls it a snapshot.

sections.title: Curgle's Reaction
sections.body: Curgle mistakes you for one of Daryn's interns and praises Daryn as a knowledgeable historian. Then Curgle goes to fetch the Super Snapper FX. Curgle is certain you will love it.

faq.answer: Daryn Lightwind sends you to Tanaris with a letter. Her research keeps her from going herself.
Curgle Cranklehop is in Tanaris and made an invention for Daryn that can capture a picture. Daryn believes Curgle calls it a snapshot.

faq.q: Why does Daryn want a picture of Gammerita?
faq.answer: Daryn is fascinated by the snapjaws along the Hinterlands beach and especially wants to see Gammerita. Her research keeps her away, so a picture is the next best thing.
Gammerita is a giant snapjaw on the beach in the Hinterlands.
